args.purpose: Battery powered Bluetooth sensor node with a printed antenna

risks.text: Ground copper close to the antenna feed may detune it.
Supply decoupling distance at the radio.

priorities: Is the antenna tuned for 2.4 GHz?

args.title: Decoupling capacitor C13 is far from the radio supply pin
args.what: C13 sits 5.2 mm from the U3 supply pin, over the 3 mm limit.
args.why_it_matters: A long loop weakens decoupling and can add noise on the radio supply.
args.recommendation: Move C13 closer to the U3 supply pin in your layout tool.

args.summary: One medium issue was found: C13 is far from the radio supply pin.
top_actions: Move C13 closer to the U3 supply pin (F-001).
